text:
tanya: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 — updates docs for tiered quotas, adds an examples appendix for SDKs, and includes a per-route usage dashboard. Need a couple of quick checks before I merge tomorrow.

marco: quick read. should we call them 'tiers' or 'usage brackets'? customers keep asking in support.

tanya: product prefers 'tiers' in customer-facing docs; I kept 'brackets' in an internal note. Added a glossary entry to avoid confusion.

elise: minor: your Grafana dashboard JSON hardcodes "eu-west1". Can we change to $env_region so folks can preview other regions? Also label the panel "Requests per route (rps)" so units are explicit.

ryan: CI preview shows the example image /assets/quota-flow.png 404. Might be path mismatch after the assets reorg.

tanya: fixed the image path and swapped the region var. Pushed. Also added an SDK snippet to show how to read limit headers.

ryan: paste the snippet here so I can confirm header names. We had the infra change last year that renamed header keys.

tanya: snippet from PR comment:
```js
// JS example: read quota headers (compatibility aware)
const remaining = res.headers.get('rate-limit-remaining') || res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-remaining');
const resetSec = res.headers.get('rate-limit-reset') || res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-reset');
console.log(`remaining=${remaining}, reset=${resetSec}`);
```

elise: please add a short migration note mapping legacy -> new header names and call out deprecation timeline. Support keeps getting tickets about this.

marco: docs-lint in CI also warns: two code blocks missing fenced language and one passive-voice sentence in the 'how quotas refill' paragraph.

ci-bot: CI queued: docs-lint, linkcheck, grafana-validate.

docs-bot: docs-lint failed on PR 523 — missing fenced languages on blocks at lines ~85 and ~142; also flagged inconsistent term usage 'bracket' vs 'tier' in glossary.

tanya: will fix fences and normalize phrasing to 'tier' with parenthetical 'bracket' mention. Adding migration callout now.

ryan: also can we show a short snippet for the Python SDK variant? Some customers are on that and it's handy for the migration guide.

tanya: added python snippet:```python
# Python example reading headers
rem = resp.headers.get('rate-limit-remaining') or resp.headers.get('x-rate-limit-remaining')
reset = resp.headers.get('rate-limit-reset') or resp.headers.get('x-rate-limit-reset')
print(f"remaining={rem}, reset={reset}")
```

elise: LGTM besides the docs-bot items. After lint passes I can approve.

ci-bot: rerunning CI: docs-lint passed; linkcheck found one broken external link to a partner dashboard doc (404).

marco: I replaced the external link with an internal guide and updated wording. Pushed.

ci-bot: all checks passed.

tanya: merged PR (merge commit 1868007808). Left a short note in the release highlights about header renames and the new per-route dashboard example. Closing thread. :tada:
